TICKET
# When changing a theme , a "yaml" cache folder is created in wrong Prestashop folders

When using a child theme and launching a PHP script that is bootstrapping Prestashop core, 
a "yaml" folder with JSON/cache content is being created in the same directory of the script instead of the cache folder.

## Attendu
I'm expecting yaml folder is being kept in /var/cache/ folder

## Étapes
1. Install a child theme as described here  ( https://devdocs.prestashop.com/1.7/themes/reference/template-inheritance/parent-child-feature/ ) 

2/A. Open your website front office, you'll notice a "yaml" folder is being created in Prestashop root :
![2022-02-10_09-19-28](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43071148/153366142-491d1c87-9bb4-4271-9952-4c043cd9b288.png)

or : 

2/B. Launch a module cronjob (like gsitemap one) - You'll notice a "yaml" folder with cache content is being created into the module directory : 

![2022-02-10_09-22-15](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43071148/153366570-22e7ea56-cb83-4d74-bf7d-5bb8a999846c.png)
